## Selected systems

- Doctreen: Production medical AI, multi-provider LLM and RAG pipelines, DICOM vision evaluation, guardrails, benchmarks, and CI/CD.
- Vidyapath: Multi-school education platform with four role-specific portals, structured AI assistance, RAG, and Supabase.
- CodrantLabs: Founder-led product and AI engineering studio in Kerala, India (https://codrantlabs.in). Full-stack platforms, AI agents, RAG systems, and search visibility across SEO, AEO, and GEO. Adithya is a co-founder.
- Mitti Mitra: Computer-vision soil diagnostics with field-ready crop guidance.
- LensAI: Browser-region explanations without context switching.
